title: backlog.py claim writes the claims ledger under the lock record_worker takes, so a dispatch running beside a claim keeps its record
goal: bl_items.cmd_claim reads and writes the claims ledger inside the claims-ledger lock record_worker takes (the same <ledger>.lock file, with the lock function moved to bl_base since bl_dispatch imports bl_items) and writes it through a temp file of its own, so a claim made while a dispatch's record_worker runs waits for the lock and loses neither the claim's record nor the worker's worker_pid and worker_session

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
for i in ("ST-aaaaaaaa","ST-bbbbbbbb"):(r/"items"/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps({"id":i,"kind":"story","title":"t "+i,"status":"todo","priority":"P3","goal":"g","touches":["x.txt"],"checks":[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]},indent=2)+"\n")
g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
led=P.Path(g("rev-parse","--absolute-git-dir"))/"kb-backlog-claims.json";lock=led.with_name(led.name+".lock")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk");env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None)
claim=lambda i:[sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),"claim",i,"--by","w"]
s.run(claim("ST-bbbbbbbb"),check=True,capture_output=True,env=env)
lock.write_text("");p=s.Popen(claim("ST-aaaaaaaa"),stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.STDOUT,text=True,env=env);time.sleep(3)
waited=p.poll() is None
d=json.loads(led.read_text());d["ST-bbbbbbbb"]["worker_session"]="W2";led.write_text(json.dumps(d));lock.unlink()
out=p.communicate(timeout=60)[0];d=json.loads(led.read_text())
kept=d.get("ST-bbbbbbbb",{}).get("worker_session")=="W2" and "ST-aaaaaaaa" in d
print("claim waited for the ledger lock:",waited,"| both records kept:",kept,"| claim exit",p.returncode,out[-200:])
sys.exit(0 if waited and kept and p.returncode==0 else 1)
